list.title: Agent Teams
list.definition: An agent team brings several agents together to collaborate in one conversation. Each team has a master agent that leads the dialogue. Teams are configured in the backend — deleting a team never deletes its agents.
list.empty.title: No agent teams yet
list.empty.description: Teams group agents that work together. They are created by configuring profiles in the backend.
detail.notFoundSub: The team "{{id}}" does not exist or is no longer available.
roster.title: Members
roster.masterHint: The master agent leads the team conversation and delegates to the other members.
roster.emptyDesc: Members are added to a team via backend profile configuration.
entities.experts.emptyDesc: Experts scoped to this team will appear here.
entities.concepts.emptyDesc: Concepts scoped to this team will appear here.
entities.rules.emptyDesc: Rules scoped to this team will appear here.
readOnly.note: Teams are read-only in this build — membership and master are configured in the backend.
